summary: Holding his chest, Neo struggles to get up while the three Agents wait for the elevator at the end of the hall. Agent Smith glances back, rips off his sunglasses, and stares at Neo "as if he were looking at a ghost." When Neo gets to his feet, all three Agents grab for their guns and, as one, fire. Neo shouts "No!", raises his hands, and the bullets "slow and come to a stop," hanging frozen "like stainless steel stars." The Agents "are unable to absorb what they are seeing." Neo plucks one bullet from the air, its casing reflecting him and the hall; the camera moves closer until the bullet fills the frame and the reflection morphs into the "real" image. He drops it, the others fall, and Neo now sees through the Matrix, the walls, floor, and Agents becoming "a rushing stream of code."

what_changes.before: Wounded and struggling on the floor, vulnerable to the Agents.
what_changes.after: Upright and in command, able to halt bullets and perceive the Matrix's underlying code.
what_changes.evidence: Holding his chest, Neo struggles to get up.

what_changes.before: In control, opening fire to kill him.
what_changes.after: Stunned and overwhelmed, unable to comprehend what they are witnessing.
what_changes.evidence: The Agents are unable to absorb what they are seeing.

what_changes.before: Perceiving the hall and the Agents as ordinary reality.
what_changes.after: Seeing through the curtain of the Matrix into its code.
what_changes.evidence: Neo looks out, now able to see through the curtain of the Matrix.

event_hint.one_line: Neo, shot at by the Agents, stops their bullets and awakens to his power over the Matrix.

minds.wants: To stop being shot—to make the violence simply not land—without having to think about how.
minds.feels: A certainty arriving faster than understanding: the world no longer resists him. The fear of death that governed every prior scene is gone, replaced by something like recognition, as if he has finally remembered a language he always spoke.
minds.shows: A single word—"No!"—and a raised hand, almost reflexive, not a battle stance. He does not gloat or even seem to grasp the magnitude of what he's done until after the bullets fall.
minds.basis: He halts the volley with a gesture and a refusal rather than a plan, then plucks one bullet with curiosity rather than triumph; the morphing reflection into 'real' image and the shift to seeing code show his perception, not just his power, has changed. Grounding in the kiss/resurrection arc in sc-213–215 (Trinity's love bringing him back) and ev-035 framing him as returned.

believes_about.belief: They are no longer threats but rules he can see around.
believes_about.wrong_because: He has not yet tested whether this command extends to a foe who refuses the rules entirely (Smith); his new certainty is real but incomplete.

minds.wants: To reassert the expected order—this anomaly must be corrected, erased like every other.
minds.feels: For the first time, something his programming has no category for: not anger, but the vertigo of a rule producing an impossible result. The 'ghost' he sees is a contradiction his logic cannot resolve, and it reads, in him, as dread.
minds.shows: Ripping off his sunglasses to look directly—an uncharacteristic, almost involuntary need to see clearly what he cannot believe. He still commands the volley, performing certainty he no longer has.
minds.basis: The 'looking at a ghost' beat precedes the shooting and is the only crack in his composure; the shared inability of the Agents to 'absorb what they are seeing' shows comprehension failing across all three, led by Smith's glance back.

believes_about.belief: Neo is a program to be deleted—dead, or about to be.
believes_about.wrong_because: Neo has crossed into a mode of being the Agents cannot compute; Smith's certainty that the system will obey him against Neo is exactly what this scene disproves.

minds.wants: To complete the kill as a single, synchronized instrument.
minds.feels: A system error made flesh: their unified action meets an effect with no cause, and in that gap their confidence simply stops. They are, for once, passive—unable to do anything but witness.
minds.shows: Firing 'as one,' then frozen into stillness and silence; no commands, no advance, only the shared failure to process. Their weapons drop from relevance the instant the bullets hang.
minds.basis: They fire in unison, then the text states outright they 'are unable to absorb what they are seeing'—the only moment in the scene where action gives way to pure stunned reception.

connects_back: Trinity's declaration of love and the kiss in sc-213–214, and her 'Now get up!' in sc-215, which return Neo to life and precede his standing here.
The prior pattern of Neo being physically overmatched by the Agents (Hotel, subway), so his stopping the bullets reads as the reversal of an established power relation.
Smith's habit of removing sunglasses to scrutinize an anomaly, carried forward as the 'ghost' look.
sets_up: ev-036 (Neo's Message to the Matrix): his new ability to see the code beneath the world underwrites his authority to now address and reshape the Matrix directly.
ev-037 (the Lobby Assault): the confidence that the rules no longer bind him licenses the open, unafraid violence he and Trinity will unleash.
The coming confrontation in which Smith will refuse the rules Neo now commands—this scene's certainty is what that fight will test.
dramatic_function: It converts Neo's resurrection from a private miracle into a public fact of power, inverting the Agent/human hierarchy so that the hunters become the stunned witnesses—marking the story's turn from escape to declaration.
